usedFor: Beeminder keeps goals on track, and “Update Goal” and “Delete Datapoint” change a goal or remove recorded progress.

bestTemplate.name: “Update Goal” in Beeminder
bestTemplate.why: It changes a goal's settings from another step, so the goal follows your plans.

watchOut: “Create Charge” charges an amount to the user's account, so keep it out of any step you have not checked.
